about.label: About
about.headline: From Biology to Code, From Lab to Product
about.p1: I'm a Biomedical Engineer finishing my degree at UNC Córdoba, specializing in AI for medical imaging. My thesis — TraumaVision — is a clinical decision support system that detects fractures in X-rays with 97.18% accuracy.
about.p2: In 2025 I founded Eleven, an AI-first digital agency. We build web products and AI agents for SMBs. It runs on Next.js, Claude API, and GSAP — the same stack I use for everything.
about.p3: I've spent two seasons working in California, which means my English is real, not classroom. I won first place at Rocking the Industry, the first industrial hackathon run by RTS Group.
about.p4: Cross-disciplinary isn't a weakness. It's the feature.

traumavision.label: Thesis Project — UNC Córdoba, 2025
traumavision.title: TraumaVision AI
traumavision.subtitle: Clinical Support System for Fracture Detection in Emergency X-Rays
traumavision.description: End-to-end CDSS for fracture detection in X-ray images. DenseNet + YOLOv8 backbone with Grad-CAM explainability. Full-stack: FastAPI + SQLite + Google OAuth + PDF reports.
